method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: Jensen Huang reinstated as Nvidia CEO. Stock skyrockets 31%
Equities.summary: The Nvidia board said it had input from senior levels of the U.S. government.
Equities.reason: Direct, market-moving catalyst: reinstatement of Nvidia CEO triggers a massive tech/AI-led rally, large liquidity flows back into AI leaders and broad risk-on repositioning. Very high relevance to overall equity sentiment and positioning.

Equities.title: Asian stocks rally as Huang's return to Nvidia revives the AI trade
Equities.reason: Confirms cross-border spillover of the Nvidia-led risk-on move: Asian markets and chip suppliers rally, reinforcing a regional/global equity bid and momentum into cyclicals/tech.

Equities.title: S&P 500: Strong rebound and ambitious 2027 target – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank projects the S&P 500 reaching 9,000 by end-2027. The bank highlights Monday’s 4.73% rally following Jensen Huang’s reinstatement as Nvidia CEO, with resilient global PMIs, falling oil prices and low equity positioning also providing support.
Equities.reason: Bullish institutional price-path / narrative that amplifies the short-term rally into a longer-term constructive view for equities; supportive but a single forecast so moderated relevance.

Equities.title: Citadel Securities Says 2018 Playbook Warns of More Market Pain
Equities.reason: Notable cautionary signal from a major market player pointing to potential further volatility/deleveraging. Acts as a counterweight to the rally—relevant for risk management and positioning.

Equities.title: Jensen Huang is ‘too big to fire,’ putting Nvidia’s governance in focus: analysts
Equities.summary: Jensen Huang’s return has underscored Nvidia’s deep reliance on its founder, putting the company's board oversight and corporate governance under scrutiny.
Equities.reason: Corporate-governance concern that raises medium-term risk/discount to Nvidia and the concentration risk in the AI trade. Relevant to structural durability of the rally but lower immediate market influence.

Equities.title: Franklin Templeton Urges Investors to Look Beyond the AI Trade
Equities.reason: Institutional note urging diversification / caution versus concentrated AI positioning. Mildly bearish signal that tempers the prevailing bullish narrative but limited immediate market-moving power.

Rates.title: Fed's John Williams indicates higher interest rates likely 'over time' to address inflation
Rates.summary: The influential central banker expressed confidence that inflation will get closer to the Fed's 2% target in 2027.
Rates.reason: Senior Fed official signalling that rates will likely need to be higher 'over time' is a hawkish policy signal that pushes Treasury yields up and is highly relevant to rates markets.

Rates.title: Wall Street soars on Huang's return to Nvidia, Treasury yields rise
Rates.reason: Market-driven rise in Treasury yields tied to an equity rally — relevant to rates but primarily an equity-flow story, so moderate negative impulse for bond prices.

Rates.title: Market rout kills 50 basis points December Fed rate hike bets
Rates.reason: Market repricing that reduces odds of a December Fed hike lowers forward rate expectations and supports bond prices — a clear positive for rates.

Rates.title: Commerzbank Weighs Partial Withdrawal From US Treasury Market
Rates.reason: A major dealer considering reduced participation in the U.S. Treasury market implies weaker structural demand for Treasuries, a meaningful negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: Australia Bonds Set for Longest Rally Since June on RBA Cut Bets
Rates.reason: Local bond rally driven by growing bets on RBA easing; positive for Australian rates and indicates easing-rate expectations in the region.

Rates.title: South Korea Considers Potential $3 Billion Dollar Bond Sale
Rates.reason: Potential sovereign dollar bond issuance implies modest incremental supply pressure on global dollar rates; low relevance unless sale size/format confirmed.

FX.title: Japanese Yen strengthens amid intervention fears, traders await US PCE inflation data
FX.summary: The USD/JPY pair declines to near 158.95 during the early Asian trading hours on Tuesday. The Japanese Yen (JPY) edges higher against the US Dollar (USD) as traders remain on high alert for market action, recalling the joint US-Japan currency intervention exec
FX.reason: JPY strength vs USD (USD/JPY down to ~158.95) plus explicit intervention fears is a high‑impact FX narrative — supportive for non‑USD currencies and potentially market moving, hence high relevance and positive direction for FX (non‑USD) exposure.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index softens below 104.50, renewed AI euphoria underpins Fed hike bets
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), an index of the value of the US Dollar (USD) measured against a basket of six world currencies, currently trades near 104.25 in the early European trading hours on Tuesday. The DXY trades on a softer note but remains near its highest
FX.reason: DXY softening (from highs) implies a short‑term relief for non‑USD currencies. The story is DXY‑centric and materially affects FX flows, so positive direction for non‑USD with meaningful relevance.

FX.title: US Dollar Index Price Forecast: Experts flag rally near 104.60 as overdone
FX.summary: The US Dollar (USD) outperforms its major currency peers on Tuesday, with the US Dollar Index (DXY) trading marginally higher at around 104.37. Still, the DXY is close to its 20-month high of 104.57 posted on Monday.
FX.reason: DXY near multi‑month highs — primary narrative is USD strength (negative for non‑USD FX). The ‘overdone’ caution is a moderating signal, so direction is USD‑positive (negative here) with medium relevance.

FX.title: Euro languishes at 19-month lows amid reviving hopes of aggressive Fed hikes
FX.summary: The Euro (EUR) consolidates losses against a stronger US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday as the sharp rally of AI stocks has fuelled hopes that the Federal Reserve (Fed) might go for a large rate hike in December.
FX.reason: Clear USD‑strength narrative (Fed hike bets driven by AI rally) pushing EUR to 19‑month lows — broad macro driver with high relevance and negative direction for EUR/USD (i.e., USD up).

FX.title: Australian Dollar gathers strength above 0.6600 on risk-on mood, traders brace for US PCE data
FX.summary: The AUD/USD pair gathers strength to near 0.6630 during the early European trading hours on Tuesday. The Australian Dollar (AUD) rebounds from an 11-month low amid improved risk sentiment. Traders await the US ADP employment report, due on Tuesday.
FX.reason: AUD rebound on risk‑on sentiment supports AUD/USD (non‑USD strength). Risk‑driven currency moves matter but are more tactical, so moderate positive direction and relevance.

FX.title: Canadian Dollar trades weakly against US Dollar, US PCE in focus
FX.summary: The Canadian Dollar (CAD) reflects broader weakness against the US Dollar (USD) on Tuesday. In the Asian trade, the USD/CAD pair trades close to its 19-month high of 1.4385 posted the previous day.
FX.reason: USD/CAD near 19‑month highs signals USD strength vs CAD; strong USD narrative driven by Fed expectations — meaningful regionally for CAD and cross‑asset flows (negative for CAD).

FX.title: British Pound trades vulnerably against US Dollar on revival of US AI stocks
FX.summary: The British Pound (GBP) is under pressure against the US Dollar (USD) in the Asian session on Tuesday, trading close to its fresh yearly low of 1.3011 posted the previous day.
FX.reason: GBP weakness against USD tied to AI‑led US equity rally and Fed hike expectations — a clear USD‑strength macro narrative with above‑average relevance for G10 FX.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar trades with caution as NASDAQ revival boosts US Dollar’s outlook
FX.summary: The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) trades close to its 17-year low at around 0.5433 against the US Dollar (USD) in the Asian trading session on Tuesday.
FX.reason: NZD near multi‑year lows as USD outlook improves on equity/NASDAQ revival — USD‑centric downside for NZD with normal relevance.

FX.title: EUR/USD Price Forecast: Inches higher above 1.0900 but stays bearish amid oversold conditions
FX.summary: The EUR/USD pair trades in positive territory around 1.0910 during the early European session on Tuesday.
FX.reason: Short‑term EUR/USD bounce inside an overall bearish USD‑dominated regime — minor positive signal for EUR with limited relevance (technical/near‑term).

FX.title: Swiss Franc trades calm against US Dollar, PCE data in focus
FX.summary: The Swiss Franc (CHF) trades broadly flat against the US Dollar (USD) at around 0.8415 during the late Asian trading session on Tuesday. The Swiss Franc pair has flattened after the rally hits a pause near 0.8444 last week.
FX.reason: CHF range‑trading/flat vs USD is low‑signal for the broader USD narrative; included for completeness with very low relevance.

FX.title: CEE FX: Central banks seen key to recovery – ING
FX.summary: ING strategist Frantisek Taborsky notes a revival in risk appetite across Central and Eastern European (CEE) markets on Monday, with rallies in both rates and FX despite a stronger US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: Regional note: CEE FX rallies despite a stronger USD — indicates central‑bank and local drivers can offset USD strength in pockets; small positive direction and low relevance for broader FX.

FX.title: Singapore, China Deepen Yuan Ties With Focus on Corporates
FX.reason: Title signals policy/cooperation to deepen yuan usage between Singapore and China — likely supportive for RMB internationalisation and non‑USD flows in Asia. Moderate relevance for FX given potential structural impact on USD/RMB flows.

Commodities.title: Oil flows through Middle East chokepoints increased in the third quarter
Commodities.summary: Collective oil shipments through key chokepoints around the Middle East increased by 19% in the third quarter of 2026 (3Q26), according to our recently published Global Energy Security Data.
Commodities.reason: 19% rise in shipments through Middle East chokepoints implies higher crude flows into world markets, increasing available supply and reducing risk premium — bearish for oil prices (commodity supply-led signal).

Commodities.title: Category 2 Hurricane Isaias nears landfall, leading to production shut-ins
Commodities.summary: As of 4:00 a.m. central time on October 9, the National Oceanic and Atmospheric Administration expects Hurricane Isaias to make landfall on the Gulf Coast late Friday or early Saturday, creating the potential for significant disruptions to energy infrastructur
Commodities.reason: Gulf Coast landfall risk can force production and refinery shut-ins, tightening near-term crude/natural gas supply — supportive for energy prices in the short run; localized and temporary so relevance is moderate.

Commodities.title: Oil holds near three-month low as rising supply offsets Hormuz threat
Commodities.reason: Market narrative: rising global supply (including Middle East flows, restarts) is outweighing geopolitical risk around Hormuz — a material bearish regime signal for crude with above-normal relevance.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD grips recovery above $43; outlook remains cautious
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) trades flat at around $43.20 during the Asian trade on Tuesday. The white metal holds onto its recovery move that came after hitting a fresh 14-month low at $40.78 last week.
Commodities.reason: Technical/price-forecast item: recovery from a 14-month low suggests tentative support for silver, but this is price-technical in nature and given guidance relevance is capped (lower structural signal).

Commodities.title: Gold gives back early gains as global AI stocks regain traction
Commodities.summary: Gold price (XAU/USD) surrenders its early gains and turns marginally lower at around $3,620 during the early Asian session on Tuesday. The precious metal edges drops amid a U-turn in global Artificial Intelligence (AI) stocks after giant chipmaker Nvidia reins
Commodities.reason: Equities/AI-led risk-on reduces safe-haven demand for gold — price-action/flow-driven downward impulse. Classified as price/market commentary so relevance capped.

Commodities.title: Copper Erases Nvidia Bounce on ‘Multiple Reasons’ to Be Short
Commodities.reason: Headline signals renewed bearish positioning in copper (investor flow/short bias and demand concerns). Industrial-metal sell signal with meaningful relevance to copper prices and market positioning.

Commodities.title: U.S. natural gas inventories end injection season above normal levels
Commodities.summary: Working natural gas in storage in the Lower 48 states ended the natural gas injection season at 3,810 billion cubic feet (Bcf), exceeding the five-year average by almost 2%, according to estimates based on data from our Weekly Natural Gas Storage Report releas
Commodities.reason: Inventories finishing the injection season above the five-year average implies looser-than-expected supply/demand balance heading into winter — bearish for natural gas prices (fundamental inventory signal).

Crypto.title: Cathie Wood's ARK Invest pulls the plug on two planned crypto ETFs
Crypto.reason: Cancellation of planned crypto ETFs by a high-profile asset manager reduces near-term institutional distribution prospects and dents investor enthusiasm for ETF-led inflows.

Crypto.title: Fidelity Investments, Strive, Etoro join OKX-ICE tokenized securities venue
Crypto.reason: Major financial firms joining a tokenized securities platform is a clear institutional-adoption signal that expands on‑chain use cases and potential regulated capital flows into tokenized assets.

Crypto.title: Eric Trump-backed American Bitcoin secures $150 million loan against its bitcoin
Crypto.reason: Institutional lending against BTC signals maturation of crypto capital markets and financing tools, supporting liquidity and use cases, though it also increases leverage/market-structure risk.

Crypto.title: Binance hackers push $247 million through transactions designed to cloud the source
Crypto.reason: Large-scale obfuscated movement of stolen funds undermines exchange custody/security trust and raises systemic counterparty and AML concerns — a significant negative for market confidence.

Crypto.title: Japan to ramp up crypto tax audits after uncovering $24.5 million in hidden income
Crypto.reason: Increased tax enforcement signals tighter regulatory scrutiny, potentially discouraging retail/wholesale flows and increasing compliance costs for market participants.

Crypto.title: U.S. CFTC sets policies on event contract data, using crypto to check financial boxes
Crypto.reason: Regulatory clarification from a major U.S. regulator provides legal certainty on data/policy handling, which generally supports institutional participation and product development.

Crypto.title: Crypto thieves are using online ads to infect iPhones with a single tap, research finds
Crypto.reason: Active malware campaigns targeting mobile wallets increase security risk for retail users and can suppress on‑chain activity and trust in self-custody solutions.

Crypto.title: Bitcoin's losing streak is second-longest ever, and some observers see more downside
Crypto.reason: Extended negative price momentum for BTC weighs on risk appetite and can trigger further deleveraging and outflows from speculative holders.

Crypto.title: More on the pending oversight hearings: State of Crypto
Crypto.reason: Ongoing political oversight and hearings increase regulatory risk and policy uncertainty for the sector, which can depress institutional risk-taking and retail confidence.

Crypto.title: Ethereum wallets holding $72 billion ETH are under threat of a future quantum attack
Crypto.reason: Longer‑term cryptographic threats, even if theoretical, raise concerns about protocol resilience and custodial risk; this dampens confidence in ETH holdings until mitigations are clearly planned.

Crypto.title: This Swedish bitcoin treasury firm lost 30 BTC trading part of its own stack
Crypto.reason: Operational/trading losses by a treasury-style holder highlight execution and risk-management pitfalls for firms with on‑chain treasuries; a localized but relevant negative signal for professional holders.
